name: xauusd-command-center
description: Personal XAUUSD trading command center — analysis, planning, journaling, replay/backtesting and risk management. Not a trading bot.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build:core && npm run build:providers
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @xau/web
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @xau/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @xau/core && npm run test -w @xau/providers
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @xau/core && npm run typecheck -w @xau/providers && npm run typecheck -w @xau/web
